first.text:
Draft's updated and the dry run is clean on both changes. Here's what it would record, and the three calls I need from you.

**1. Pull-up dose.** The strict pull-up's weekly figure now counts the negatives and the band pull-ups as well as the strict single, so it finally has a real target. I've put it at **10 hard sets a week**, and here's why: the week as written already delivers 3 negatives and 7 band sets, plus the one strict single — about 11. A target of 10 is what you're already doing, so it opens the block without asking for more. That matters right now: last Wednesday your fourth band set was 4 reps at a true limit and the negatives held at 2, so this isn't the moment to add volume. The alternative is 8, the default, which leaves slack for a missed Wednesday without reading as "behind"; 12 would be a genuine raise and I wouldn't take it yet. The old explanation for why the pull-up sat below the band is gone, and nothing fires on it now. Your call: 10 or 8.

**2. Swings.** Removed from Monday's lifting and given their own session scheduled beside it, optional, so a skipped one never counts against you. The scheme: one set at the top of each minute, 12 minutes to start, growing by 2 to a cap of 16; 12 reps a set to start, cap 15; progress whenever the session comes in at effort 7 or under. Load 40 lb (18.1 kg), as before. Monday's lifting drops from 58 to 47 minutes of its 75, so the swings fit after it comfortably. On the hard-set question: once this is adopted, anything logged against the swing session is read as conditioning, not lifting, so it won't add glute or hamstring sets to the weekly count. Your 2 November swings stay exactly where you logged them and will still count as hard sets for that week — history isn't touched. I'll confirm the new behaviour on the planned week right after adopting, and again from the first week that closes with a swing session in it.

**3. Circuit.** Unchanged, and re-checking this week's plan under the new engine shows nothing on it. The circuit is judged from what you actually log now, so stacking it on a Monday would be noticed only if you did it, and there's nothing to wave through each week any more.

**One thing surfaced that needs a decision.** With the pull-up fixed, the dry run now shows the **deadlift target of 4** sitting below the 5–15 band. It was there before, hidden behind the pull-up. Sunday already prescribes 5 working sets (top set plus 4 back-offs), so 4 understates what the session delivers. I'd raise it to 5, the floor of the band and what Sunday actually does; the other option is to leave it at 4 with a stated reason (the home bar cap, the PT's occasional deadlifts). Say which and I'll fold it in.

**Everything else the dry run reports:**
- The strict pull-up single stays a weekly measure rather than a progression — already acknowledged, unchanged.
- One of your Hevy routines has drifted from this week's plan: reps changed on sets 5–7 of its first exercise and weights on the second. Something edited in the app. It sorts itself out the next time routines are pushed, which you're holding off on anyway.
- No other session changed. All the other time estimates are unchanged and under budget.
- No publish, as asked.

Give me the pull-up target, the deadlift call, and a yes, and I'll record it.
